headline: CDMX Government Strengthens Educational Infrastructure with Historic Investment of More Than 14 mil mdp (14 billion pesos): Clara Brugada
summary: Mexico City head of government Clara Brugada said the administration has invested more than 14 billion pesos in school infrastructure. Maintenance has reached 2,309 public schools, with 628 more set to receive work.
why: Mexico City's public spending on infrastructure supports local construction and services. Municipal budget commitments indicate the scale of public investment in the capital.
original_headline: Fortalece Gobierno CDMX infraestructura educativa con inversión histórica de más de 14 mil mdp: Clara Brugada
